# Explicitly unsupported procedure forms must fail without side effects.
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS errors_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE errors_procedures.proc_strict() BEGIN SELECT 1; END
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS errors_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE errors_procedures.proc_strict_true() OPTIONS(strict_mode=TRUE) BEGIN SELECT 1; END
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS errors_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE errors_procedures.proc_system() OPTIONS(strict_mode=FALSE) BEGIN SET @@dataset_id = 'other'; END;
BEGIN CALL errors_procedures.proc_system(); EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN SELECT 1; END
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS errors_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE errors_procedures.proc_function() OPTIONS(strict_mode=FALSE) BEGIN CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f() AS (1); END;
BEGIN CALL errors_procedures.proc_function(); EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN SELECT 1; END
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS errors_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE errors_procedures.proc_dynamic() OPTIONS(strict_mode=FALSE)
BEGIN EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT 1'; END;
BEGIN CALL errors_procedures.proc_dynamic(); EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN SELECT 1; END
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

# Unbound named parameters can be rejected before CALL is reached.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/parameterized-queries
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS errors_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE errors_procedures.proc_parameters() OPTIONS(strict_mode=FALSE)
BEGIN SELECT @caller_parameter; END;
BEGIN CALL errors_procedures.proc_parameters(); EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN SELECT 1; END
=> error:
